name: The Ritz-Carlton, Osaka
positioning: Hotel in Umeda, Osaka, with interiors reminiscent of an 18th-century British aristocratic residence; its official name is The Ritz-Carlton, Osaka
best_for: Travelers who like a classic, residential-style interior
Families interested in the Ritz Kids Night Safari
Food lovers who want French, Japanese, Chinese and Italian restaurants in one hotel

facts.text: The hotel stands in the heart of Umeda, Osaka.
The interior is reminiscent of an 18th-century British aristocratic residence.
The guest rooms and suites occupy the 24th through the 37th floors.
Xiang Tao, the Chinese restaurant, features Cantonese cuisine and other regional Chinese dishes.
Splendido is an all-day Italian restaurant on the first floor that serves breakfast.
The Riedel Room is a private dining room with gilt mirrors and hand-carved furnishings.
Spa treatments include the Shisui Detox Facial with matcha and the Ki Purifier & Rebalancer with sake.
The hotel offers staying guests complimentary activities such as running tours, origami lessons and bike rentals.
The Ritz Kids Night Safari for families provides a tent, mattress and lantern in the room.
Osaka Station is less than half a mile from the hotel.

highlights.text: La Baie, the French restaurant, was awarded one Michelin star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2026.
The Japanese Suite has a tateiwa stone entrance, cedar-paneled bathroom walls and a granite soaking tub.
Hanagatami, the Japanese restaurant, has a seven-meter cypress sushi counter and serves sumibiyaki fired over ubame oak charcoal.
The hotel holds an art collection and offers an art tour exclusively for in-house guests.
Forbes Travel Guide gave the hotel its Five-Star rating in 2026, for the fourth consecutive year.

considerations.text: Umeda is a transport hub and business district.
Guests with tattoos, including small fashion tattoos, are asked not to use the spa area.
Club Lounge access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: The Ritz-Carlton, Osaka
